review_focus: Paragraph 1: transition from Sumner proofs to 'so desperate'.
Paragraph 5: opening sentence after the 'victim of the scholar' cut.
Paragraph 13: whether the paragraph's opening on secretaries detesting their chiefs reads cleanly.
risks: The estimated reduction is close to 861 words but has not been measured by code.
'Taken one so desperate' in paragraph 1 now rests on the appointment generally rather than on the explicit safe-seat contrast.
summary: Removed about 860 words, mainly through whole-sentence deletions. Cuts targeted the editorial asides in the appointment section, secondary detail in the voyage and adventurer passage, reflective sentences after the recognition shock, gloom elaborations, and the longer Milnes/Forster characterization. All eight protected excerpts are kept verbatim. The Trent, Times and Delane sequence is kept nearly whole.
